LESSON: HANDWRITING

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: WRITING
Topic 3.3: Handwriting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Handwriting. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use appropriate spacing between words
2. use legible and neat handwriting to communicate effectively
3. appreciate the importance of linking words in paragraph development pair- share to discuss linking words Core-Competence to be developed: Learning to learn: learners practice handwriting to improve in it

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use appropriate spacing between words
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use appropriate spacing between words. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. use legible and neat handwriting to communicate effectively
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use legible and neat handwriting to communicate effectively. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. appreciate the importance of linking words in paragraph development pair- share to discuss linking words Core-Competence to be developed: Learning to learn: learners practice handwriting to improve in it
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of linking words in paragraph development pair- share to discuss linking words Core-Competence to be developed: Learning to learn: learners practice handwriting to improve in it. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Handwriting.
2. Explain Handwriting to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Handwriting.
4. Show that you can: use appropriate spacing between words
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Handwriting. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Handwriting important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. use appropriate spacing between words
2. use legible and neat handwriting to communicate effectively
3. appreciate the importance of linking words in paragraph development pair- share to discuss linking words Core-Competence to be developed: Learning to learn: learners practice handwriting to improve in it

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
